summary: Phase F13 — Analytics Data Integrity Overhaul: All 10/10 acceptance tests PASSED (100% backend success). Verified the shared lib/analytics_scope.eligible_ship_match predicate correctly excludes Cancelled/Cancel-by-buyer/Returned, is_demo:true, and soft-deleted rows from /api/shipments/stats (Home KPIs), /api/me/audience[/stats|/{key}] (Audience list, stats, VIP ranking), /api/analytics/overview, while still preserving them in the audience profile's `orders` history array with is_cancelled=true. Case-normalisation (shipped vs Shipped merging), explicit status=Cancelled override on /api/analytics/overview, and multi-tenant isolation (admin vs user2) all verified. No frontend testing performed per request.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_scope.py is well-documented and correctly composes filters; the $expr/$or merge logic in eligible_ship_match() handles the tricky case of multiple $expr / $or clauses without clobbering.
audience.py: get_audience_profile fetches all shipments (including cancelled) then filters via is_eligible_status for KPIs — correct per requirement E.
shipments_read.py: shipments_stats uses aggregation with normalize_status_expr() to case-merge 'shipped'/'Shipped' into a single lowercase bucket — verified.

analytics.py: overview endpoint correctly detects explicit terminal-status override (status=Cancelled) via explicit_terminal flag and passes include_cancelled=True to eligible_ship_match — verified with test.
reports.py _weight_aggregate correctly uses eligible_only=True; return-analysis intentionally uses eligible_only=False so it can see terminal-status rows (correct).
seed_data_creation: Tests create shipments tagged with 'F13TEST_<uuid6>' via /api/shipments API and delete them via DELETE /api/shipments/{id} in a finally block. All seeded data is cleaned up per-test; no persistent test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_f13_analytics_integrity.py covers 10 acceptance scenarios (A/B COD cancel, C Prepaid cancel, D demo/deleted exclusion, E cancelled-in-history-not-in-KPI, F VIP ranking safety, G cross-endpoint consistency (2 tests), status case-normalisation with drift seeding, analytics/overview default-exclude vs explicit-include cancelled, multi-tenant isolation). Requires env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL to be set. Use `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest tests/test_phase_f13_analytics_integrity.py -v`.
